color.$description: Brand-level and ui-package component tokens — the only source of visual color values in the workspace (docs/architecture-overview.md non-negotiable #2).

disabled.$description: Disabled text/control label — light. WCAG exempts disabled content from the 4.5:1 minimum.

inverse.$description: Text on a solid `color.solid.*` fill — always white, independent of theme; verified ≥4.5:1 against every solid fill in ui-tokens-contrast.test.mjs.

focus.$description: Focus ring — light. Clears 3:1 against color.background.primary (WCAG 2.4.11).

solid.$description: Interactive solid fills (Button) paired with `color.text.inverse`. Deliberately theme-invariant — a fill dark enough for white text to clear 4.5:1 in light mode is exactly as dark in dark mode, so light.json and dark.json repeat the same values rather than reusing the theme-adaptive `primary`/`secondary` tokens (which are tuned for text/icon-on-background use, not fill-with-white-text — see ui-tokens-contrast.test.mjs).

success.$description: Badge/Alert solid fill only (not interactive, no hover) — green.600 fails 4.5:1 against white text (3.30:1), so this uses green.800 instead of mirroring color.status.success.

warning.$description: Badge/Alert solid fill only — amber.600 fails 4.5:1 against white text (3.19:1), so this uses amber.800 instead of mirroring color.status.warning.

learn.$description: Course learn-view spine — consumed directly by @sanvi/course-media's layout primitives

spine.$description: The spine's neutral tick/rule color, before a lecture is reached — light

accent.$description: Six-hue course accent set, assigned to a course by a deterministic hash of its primary category ID (see @sanvi/course-media's accentForCategory) — never invented per render

state.$description: Quiz answer states (Phase 8) — defined in Phase 1 so the palette is contrast-checked once

chart.$description: Chart primitives (phase 10, TASK-016) — the only colors chart components may reference, so charts cannot drift into a second design system. All series tokens clear 3:1 (WCAG non-text) against color.background.primary in both themes; asserted in ui-tokens-contrast.test.mjs.

spend.$description: Chart series — spend (bars/lines). Non-text graphic: clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.

revenue.$description: Chart series — revenue (bars/lines). Non-text graphic: clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.

grid.$description: Chart gridlines and axis baselines — decorative, exempt from the 3:1 non-text minimum.

series.1.$description: Categorical chart series 1 — multi-series charts (platform breakdown). Colour is never the only encoding: charts pair these with distinct dash patterns/fills and an accessible data table. Clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.

series.2.$description: Categorical chart series 2 — multi-series charts (platform breakdown). Colour is never the only encoding: charts pair these with distinct dash patterns/fills and an accessible data table. Clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.

series.3.$description: Categorical chart series 3 — multi-series charts (platform breakdown). Colour is never the only encoding: charts pair these with distinct dash patterns/fills and an accessible data table. Clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.

series.4.$description: Categorical chart series 4 — multi-series charts (platform breakdown). Colour is never the only encoding: charts pair these with distinct dash patterns/fills and an accessible data table. Clears 3:1 against color.background.primary in both themes.
